contactId.title: Contact ID
contactId.description: The Salesforce Contact ID of the customer whose open quote to display

messagingSessionId.title: Messaging Session ID
messagingSessionId.description: The Messaging Session ID — used to resolve the Contact when Quote ID and Contact ID are not available

quoteId.title: Quote ID
quoteId.description: The Quote record Id to display. If blank, the contact's most recent open Quote is used.
